claim.claim-text: 2. The swimming pool cleaning device of the underwater robot of claim 1, wherein the water outlet component (3) includes a flow channel baffle (31) disposed on a top of an upper cover (101), a drainage cover (32) disposed on a top of the flow channel baffle (31), two impellers (33) rotatably disposed in the flow channel baffle (31), two drainage enclosures (34) disposed in the drainage cover (32), two drainage ports (35) connected to the two drainage enclosures (34), respectively and disposed on two sides of the drainage cover (32), respectively, and a water outlet flap (36) movably disposed in each drainage port (35); wherein interiors of the two impellers (33) are fixedly sleeved with output shafts of two motors (163), respectively; and wherein tops of the two impellers (33) extend into the drainage cover (32) and are arranged concentrically with centers of the two drainage enclosures (34), respectively.
